text:
sam: quick follow-up after the postmortem — two near-identical degradations during staged feature-flag rollouts. we need a compact, tracked remediation plan: owners, exact signals for auto-abort, and a way to enforce no-ops like model swap during windows.

mira: +1. let's be concrete: who owns the rule wiring, who owns smoke tests, and who will maintain the runbook. also record recurring patterns so we can tune defaults later.

pavan: suggested safe defaults: initial gate 0.5% for 5m, next 3% for 5m, then 12%. enforce a global canary cap of 3% on any active rollout. auto-abort if any of: error-rate increases by >=4 percentage points vs baseline for 3m, OR p95 latency increases by >220ms for 2m, OR schema/malformed responses exceed 0.15% in smoke.

cleo: add requirement: smoke test must run after each gate and include schema check + 50 golden prompts. if smoke fails, gate auto-aborts and creates a ticket INF-9124-rollback. i'll own alerts mapping: pager for sev2+, slack for sev3.

sam: I'll implement the rollback engine hooks and the smoke harness integration. plan: PR with tests by Tue EOD. i'll also add a small synthetic traffic generator to validate under load.

mira: i'll write runbook snippet for on-call: how to interpret aborts, how to manually pause/unpause and the override policy (requires 2 approvers). ETA runbook draft Wed AM.

pavan: i'll push a rollout-policy YAML prototype and create INF-9124 to track action items and owners. i'll also add a pre-rollout model-compat check: tokenizer checksum, model version pin, and forbid model-binary swaps during rollout windows.

sam: prototype controller config (will be committed):
```yaml
policy: "safety_net_v1"
initial_gate: 0.5%
hold: 5m
progression: [3%, 12%]
max_active_canary: 3%
abort_rules:
  - id: error_spike
    metric: error_rate
    delta: 0.04
    window: 3m
  - id: latency_regression
    metric: p95_latency
    delta_ms: 220
    window: 2m
  - id: schema_fail
    metric: schema_error_rate
    threshold: 0.0015
    window: 1m
smoke_test:
  run_after_each_gate: true
  golden_prompts: 50
  schema_threshold: 0.0015
pre_rollout_checks: [tokenizer_checksum, model_pin, no_swap_lock]
auto_abort: true
```

cleo: INF-9124 created and linked to the postmortem. owners: sam -> rollback engine + smoke harness; pavan -> policy + infra deploy; mira -> dashboards + runbook + on-call mapping. deadlines: PRs Tue EOD, infra review Wed, gated rollout Thu.

sam: will also add a circuit-breaker so canary failures don't cascade into shared caches or downstream services. this will add a kill-switch signal that infra can flip.

pavan: adding a recurring "Safety Net Review" to reassess thresholds after 3 successful rollouts. we'll log recurring-incident categories in INF-9124; last 4 incidents show tokenizer mismatch or unannounced model swap as common causes.

mira: i'll add a short table in the ticket summarizing patterns + suggested mitigations. also including exact alert queries and the p95 baseline calc so everyone knows how we compute deltas.

deploy-bot: Canary plan queued by @pavan: safety_net_v1 scheduled for 2026-12-05 03:00 UTC.

sam: final note: keep defaults conservative until we have 3 clean gated rollouts. PR will reference INF-9124 and include test artifacts when ready. :thumbsup:
